halt_handoff.text:
Loop 4 ended at HALT_SUCCESS — every scorecard category is at 10 or 9.5+ with an accepted residual. The codebase meets the contest target.

Final scorecard:
  - Architecture quality: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - State management: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Domain modeling: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Data flow: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Framework idioms: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Concurrency: 10

  - Test strategy: 9.5 (accepted residual)
  - Credibility: 9.5 (accepted residual)

Accepted residuals (won't be revisited unless you ask):
  - architecture_quality: HeadToHeadPage.tsx remains a page-level orchestrator of substantive size.
  - state_management: Undo history remains capped at 20 snapshots by product design.
  - domain_modeling: Item.status remains a user-defined string label.
  - data_flow: urlSharing.ts keeps a lossy compact share format for URL-length reasons.
  - framework_idioms: ItemModal.tsx keeps a controlled-input mediaType cast.
  - simplicity: headToHead.ts remains long because the algorithm is substantive.
  - test_strategy: no dedicated Playwright path targets ItemMedia rendering specifically.
  - credibility: useItemForm.ts keeps a UI-local mediaType string default.

Findings resolved this run:
  - F-004 (loop 3): Bundled theme catalog duplicated across Redux state and package constants — Redux now owns only selectedThemeId; selectors derive the bundled catalog from @tiercade/theme.

Tests: 243/243 pass across 36 suites.

Next step options:
  (a) Tag the loop-3 commit (baa7392) as the new baseline and move on.
  (b) Spot-check one accepted residual — say "verify <category>" and I'll re-read the cited source.
  (c) Reset and run again from current source — type "/contest-refactor --reset" if the branch changes materially.

verdict_explanation: Loop 4 re-ran the critic from the loop-3 commit and the duplicated theme-authority finding did not persist in current source. Every dimension is now at 10 or 9.5 with an accepted residual, and the full contest gate passed again from current HEAD.

architecture_quality.proof: baa7392 removed the duplicated theme catalog from Redux state and left catalog lookup derived from @tiercade/theme.
architecture_quality.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: The page remains within accepted orchestration complexity.

state_management.proof: packages/state/src/themeSlice.ts:3-9 now stores only selectedThemeId; packages/state/test/persistenceMiddleware.test.ts:89-91 proves only that mutable choice is serialized.
state_management.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Undo history remains capped at 20 snapshots by product design.

domain_modeling.proof: packages/core/src/models.ts keeps Item.media?: ItemMedia and impossible multi-URL states remain unrepresentable.
domain_modeling.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Item.status remains a user-defined string label.

data_flow.proof: packages/state/src/selectors.ts:106-116 derives the bundled catalog from @tiercade/theme, and persistence no longer carries duplicated theme data.
data_flow.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: The share format intentionally trades fidelity for URL length.

framework_idioms.proof: Reducers remain pure, selectors stay memoized, and the React/Redux integration remains idiomatic.
framework_idioms.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: The cast stays inside a controlled input path.

concurrency.proof: No source-backed concurrency hazard is present, and the runtime still has explicit cleanup.

simplicity.proof: baa7392 deleted the redundant Redux catalog field instead of layering a new seam or adapter.
simplicity.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: The file is large because the algorithm is substantive rather than ceremonial.

test_strategy.proof: The full contest gate passed from current HEAD: core 109/109, state 64/64, ui 5/5, hooks 65/65.
test_strategy.residual_blocking_10: apps/web/e2e/ lacks a dedicated ItemMedia rendering path
test_strategy.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: Unit tests cover the ItemMedia interface directly.

credibility.proof: The loop-3 refactor aligned theme ownership with the actual runtime authority and preserved the public selector interface.
credibility.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: The remaining concern is UI-local and does not weaken the architecture claim.

strengths: headToHead.ts keeps real algorithmic leverage behind a bounded interface.
createPersistenceMiddleware remains a single injectable persistence seam.
ItemMedia still encodes media invariants at the type level.
packages/core/test/dag.test.ts keeps the monorepo layering rules enforced by source.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: Loop 3 removed the only fresh drift-era ownership split.
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: Theme selection remains in Redux while the bundled catalog lives only in @tiercade/theme.
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Do not add another theme abstraction just to replace the removed field.
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: The full contest gate plus direct selector/persistence tests cover the simplified theme interface.

builder_notes.pattern: Bundled data with fake Redux ownership
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: A slice stores immutable catalog data while reducers only mutate the selection.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Keep bundled fixtures with the module that defines them; keep only mutable choices in Redux.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Callers need the same selector interface, but the authority behind it can move to a better source.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Delete the shallow field and keep the caller contract stable.

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Serialized JSON includes immutable data that code can reconstruct from constants.
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Persist user choices and runtime state, not bundled catalogs.

narrative: Win. The loop-3 simplification removed the only fresh structural deduction, runtime ownership is trustworthy again, concurrency remains trustworthy, the tests reduce regressions, and the remaining work would risk overengineering rather than improve the contest score.
